$comment: The feature grid on the product page (website/public/index.php), three to a row. Keep it in step with the app: the release skill updates it with each release, and website/test/features.test.ts holds the limits (title, text, badges). `code` in text renders as <code>.

features.title: Spaces
features.text: One per project, with its terminals, agents, browser and widgets. Switch, and the desk follows.

features.title: Layouts
features.text: Focus one window, tile a grid, scroll a strip or spread out on a canvas. Dock any as a sidebar.

features.title: Agents, recognised
features.text: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Aider and more, in any terminal, even wrapped. Each named for its work.

features.title: Needs you, on top
features.text: Waiting agents first, then working, then done. ⌃⌘J jumps to the next one that needs you.

features.title: Terminals outlive the app
features.text: A background process owns them: quit or update cmd and nothing ends. After a reboot, agents resume.

features.title: Search everything
features.text: ⇧⌘F searches windows, files, past sessions, commands and their output. Return resumes a session.

features.title: Your history, kept
features.text: Every agent session, command and commit, on your Mac with secrets redacted. You pick what's saved.

features.title: Session summaries
features.text: Right-click an agent for what you asked, what was done and what changed, in Markdown.

features.title: Magic widgets
features.text: Ask for your open PRs or last CI runs, and an agent builds a live widget from `gh`, `curl` or a script.

features.title: Built-in widgets
features.text: Agent Activity, a Live Diff, Resources, a Timer and more, in the Widget Library (⇧⌘L).

features.title: Remote access
features.text: Pair a phone or browser by QR code and take your terminals and agents along, end-to-end encrypted.

features.title: Web browser
features.text: Beside your terminals, at phone, tablet or desktop size. Pages that won't load say why.

features.title: Files and editor
features.text: A file browser with git status, and an editor. `open README.md` in a shell opens it here.

features.title: Viewers for your files
features.text: Markdown, JSON, PDF and SQLite open in windows made for them, and follow the file as it changes.

features.title: Drag and drop
features.text: Drop files on a terminal to type their paths, or anywhere to open them. Drag them out to any app.

features.title: Calm notifications
features.text: Waiting agents, bells and finished commands mark their window until you look. Nothing else nags.

features.title: Keyboard first
features.text: ⌘K finds windows, commands and sessions, ⌘F finds in any window. Every shortcut is remappable.

features.title: Themes and updates
features.text: 29 themes, light and dark, following the system or not. Updates install quietly when you quit.
